description: **TOML parse errors are reworded.** Configuration and data documents (`docs/cv.toml`, `docs/projects.toml`, the assembly roster) are decoded by go-toml-edit 0.4.0, which phrases a syntax error differently: `1:18: expected a value, got end of input` in place of `line 1, column 18: expected value, got EOF`. The `<file> is not valid TOML: ` sentence around it is unchanged.

**The assembly deploy workflow is pinned to the version just released.** The post-release hook passed no pin, so the regenerated workflow named the version of the binary on PATH -- built before the release's own version bump -- and could name a version the Go module proxy did not serve.
